picks.name: Spellslinger
picks.annotation: This is a great item for buffing our gun. Viscous uses abilities frequently so he has no trouble keeping this up.

picks.name: Crushing Fists
picks.annotation: The biggest melee item in this build!

picks.name: Ballistic Enchantment
picks.annotation: Huge range & dmg on the puddle punch.

picks.name: Recharging Rush
picks.annotation: If you really want more punches! Honestly, not necessary after the CD buff.

picks.name: Colossus
picks.annotation: Secret broken item maybe?

picks.name: Witchmail
picks.annotation: You'll take a lot of Spirit Damage late game, so this will proc a lot, granting you a lot more charges of Puddle Punch (3)!

picks.name: Phantom Strike
picks.annotation: A must pick and top priority if fighting flyers, who you'll have a hard time punching. So bring them down using this!

picks.name: Lifestrike
picks.annotation: This adds some extra healing & movement slow on the puddle punch. This is also important for hitting green spike. Can swap out for a different T3 green if needed.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Anti-Healing and Extra Burst. Easily triggered by your burst damage. |Replaces Healbane in Late Game|

picks.name: Mystic Reverb
picks.annotation: Extra burst potential, along with a strong slow and lifesteal when using Splatter (1).

picks.name: Scourge
picks.annotation: Another great item if you want to get in the thick of a fight.

picks.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
picks.annotation: Splatter (1), Mystic Shot and Spirit Snatch will trigger this. Allowing you to deal more damage with your melee or gun. |Can be sold for a slot|

picks.name: Spirit Snatch
picks.annotation: Core item.

picks.name: Transcendent Cooldown
picks.annotation: Greatly boosts uptime of all abilities!

picks.name: Rapid Recharge

source_builds.name: Concerns of The Deep? I'm Punchin'

2010028405.annotation: Increases your poke potential |Can be sold for a slot|

1437614329.annotation: Upgrade to Lifestrike. Great early healing.

1342610602.annotation: More damage on your puddle punch. Upgrade to Point Blank.

1763073141.annotation: If you really want more punches! Honestly, not necessary after the CD buff.

26002154.annotation: Upgrade to Crushing Fists. Core item!

1009965641.annotation: Helps you hold your lane and kill Troopers faster. |Can be sold for a slot|

1710079648.annotation: A decent amount of healing, useful when facing burst damage. Just make sure to hide when using this. |Upgrades into: Rescue Beam|

2829638276.annotation: Some decent sustain. Will get upgraded. |Upgrades into: Healing Booster|

4204808176.annotation: Only get if you're facing a melee-heavy lane. |Can be sold for a slot|

1672893796.annotation: A barrier on demand. Useful when going in, or trying to get out. Upgrades into many different barrier items.

754480263.annotation: Imbue on Puddle Punch. Upgrade to Ballistic Enchantment.

1235347618.annotation: Sustain, survival, fire rate and damage! You can buy a different Tier 2 Vitality item instead. |Can be sold for a slot|

1252627263.annotation: This adds some extra healing & movement slow on the puddle punch. This is also important for hitting green spike. Can swap out for a different T3 green if needed.

3294954488.annotation: Huge range & dmg on the puddle punch.

800008313.annotation: The biggest melee item in this build!

2481177645.annotation: More shredding to get the upperhand during fights, especially at close range.

1798666702.annotation: Roam around with ease, but also jump unexpected people with nice bonuses!

1193964439.annotation: More range for your whole kit, your Puddle Punch (3) will be huge!

2603935618.annotation: An easy to trigger anti-heal. Gives you a nice heal when you kill someone, as long as they had the effect on them. This can be used against Victor.

112198670.annotation: Taking too much SPIRIT damage too quickly? Take this. This item will grant you a nice Barrier and out of combat regen.

805079544.annotation: Taking too much GUN damage, too quickly? Take this. It'll give you a nice Barrier and out of combat regen.

1644605047.annotation: Useful against Mirage's Tornado, Bebop's Hook, Abrams' Charge, Haze's Sleep, Paige's immobilize, any stuns (Including getting parried!) and more!

3970837787.annotation: Survival, sustain, cooldown reduction and damage! Keep as long as possible, then replace with better resistance.

2163598980.annotation: Very useful if the enemy team is mostly Spirit oriented. (Check the colored bars when holding TAB!)

1414025773.annotation: Parry ANYTHING. This means almost any abilities such as Geist's Ultimate, Shiv's Ultimate, Lash's Ultimate, etc...

3270001687.annotation: To engage or escape. Grants some nice bullet resistance! Use it vertically for even easier escapes. You can also use it in Goo Ball (4) to change directions.

1378931225.annotation: Become immune to bullets! But mind the on-hit effects like Tesla Bullets or Mercurial Magnum! Useful against: Drifter, Haze, Silver, Venator, Vyper, Wraith and more.

3731635960.annotation: Removes Bebop's Bomb, Infernus' Burn, and more! Does NOT remove Pocket's Affliction.

1371725689.annotation: A must pick and top priority if fighting flyers, who you'll have a hard time punching. So bring them down using this!

2417568017.annotation: Another great item if you want to get in the thick of a fight.

365620721.annotation: A ton more damage with your gun, which also affects Puddle Punch (3).

2037039379.annotation: Incredibly useful to lower the enemies' healing but also damage. Works perfectly against Victor.

2221211450.annotation: This is a great item for buffing our gun. Viscous uses abilities frequently so he has no trouble keeping this up.

339443430.annotation: If you really want to get in the thick of a fight, this is helpful.

3491236900.annotation: A better pick than Metal Skin when facing enemies with On-Hit effects (Toxic Bullets, Tesla Bullets...)

1250307611.annotation: Very useful against gun-focused characters like Haze, Drifter, Wraith, Vyper and more.

3028234315.annotation: You'll take a lot of Spirit Damage late game, so this will proc a lot, granting you a lot more charges of Puddle Punch (3)!

3357231760.annotation: You cannot get stunned by parries while this is active! (Damage will still be negated) This is your pick against many CC in the late game.

1955841979.annotation: Allows you to survive with burst spirit damage. Very useful against Apollo, Bebop, Grey Talon, Lash, Mirage, and more.

951866250.annotation: Basically an Automatic Counterspell against CC. Works against Cursed Relic. If facing many CC, buy Unstoppable. Very useful against Lash's Ult, Vyper's Ult, Bebop's Hook, Doorman's Ult and much more!

1662311306.annotation: Dispel Magic but stronger and for an ally too! Does remove Ultimate-type debuffs (Drifter, Pocket...)

3361811174.annotation: This allows you to Goo Ball (4) away for free.

2533252781.annotation: Allows you to keep the Cube (2) for your teammates, while this acts as your own "Cube". Very useful against telegraphed ultimates, like Lash's.

2922054143.annotation: Makes laning more difficult for your enemies. You'll also deal more damage to them. Useful against: Haze, Wraith, Drifter, Infernus, Mina, Silver and more.

1219329868.annotation: Use it before engaging to debuff your target. Can be replaced by other Tier 2 Spirit items in the Alternative category. |Upgrades into: Focus Lens|

1813726886.annotation: Slows those pesky mobility heroes. Useful against: Apollo, Calico, Celeste, Mina, Pocket, Rem and more.

3361075077.annotation: Send back some of the damage you take. Useful when facing gun-oriented heroes.

2061878743.annotation: More useful than Metal Skin when gun-focused characters have on-hit effects. Useful against: Celeste, Drifter, Graves, Haze, Infernus, Mina and more.

1254091416.annotation: To shutdown ultimates or flying enemies! Useful against: Bebop, Celeste, Grey Talon, Kelvin, Lash, Seven and more.

3144988365.annotation: A decent anti-heal that deals damage scaling with Spirit. Useful against: Abrams, Billy, Mo&Krill, Shiv, Silver and more. DO NOT USE AGAINST VICTOR.

619484391.annotation: This item can counter Indomitable. Useful against anyone who relies on their abilities, such as Apollo, Calico, Pocket, Lady Geist, Victor and more.

2617435668.annotation: For shutting down one target in particular. Really great active item!

1152158042.annotation: Throw a SQUID from the DEEP. Pull them in! Useful against: Apollo, Calico, Celeste, Holliday, Infernus and many more.

2142980412.annotation: Increases your burst damage considerably, allowing you to secure kills.

3077079169.annotation: Helps with securing/denying souls. |Upgrades into: Express Shot|

1770441818.annotation: Lower bullet resistance means more melee damage. |Upgrade into: Crippling Headshot|

2064029594.annotation: This adds bullet velocity and a lot of damage against high HP targets.

3403085434.annotation: Use this to do some Heavy Melee Cancels! After starting a heavy melee, activate Fleetfoot to cancel it! This will allow you to trick your opponent.

393974127.annotation: Only 4 shots are required to slow down your enemy. |Upgrade into: Weighted Shots|

395867183.annotation: An increased in burst damage, especially when used with Express Shot. Both share the same cooldown!

3977876567.annotation: More fire rate but also one more stamina!

690458959.annotation: If you really like this item, go for it. I don't though :(

3696726732.annotation: If you tend to use your gun a lot, this will help deal with tanky enemies such as: Shiv, Abrams, Silver, Mo&Krill, Victor, and more.

3791587546.annotation: Lots of extra dmg and debuff resist. Movement penalty sucks, but it is what it is.

2678489038.annotation: Some resist shredding, and damage, but only at high health. Thankfully, Lifestrike will keep you topped up! Puddle Punch (3) does not trigger this, so make sure to shoot the enemy!

1414319208.annotation: The more damage you take, the stronger you'll get. This increases your melee damage!

2095565695.annotation: This adds a lot of extra damage on the puddle punch.

2226497419.annotation: More damage. You can easily trigger it by shooting the enemy around 5 times or so.

3399065363.annotation: The out of combat regen will help with sustain, while the sprint speed can help you move around to get boxes! |Upgrade into: Trophy Collector|

2566692615.annotation: Increases the lifesteal of Puddle Punch (3) but also the efficiency of Lifestrike and Radiant Regen. |Upgrades into: Healing Tempo|

1047818222.annotation: Lowers the duration of Infernus' Burn, any form of stuns, silence, immobilize and more. |Upgrade into: Spellbreaker|

2447176615.annotation: More move speed, and also regen! |Upgrade into: Juggernaut|

857669956.annotation: If you want to Support an ally, this will help them survive more! |Upgrade into: Divine Barrier|

3074274290.annotation: Broken item, this is the main source of your economy.

2059712766.annotation: Health but also Stamina upon use. Only take if you tend to frontline a lot and facing ability-spamming enemies. |Can be sold for a slot|

1804594021.annotation: If you want to be more of a Support. You can pull an ally who is in The Cube (2).

3585132399.annotation: This means you don't have to go back to base to heal!

3140772621.annotation: Very useful if the enemy team is mostly Bullet oriented. (Check the colored bars when holding TAB!)

1427630806.annotation: A lot of fire rate whenever you use your Cube (2) or use Lifestrike.

380806748.annotation: Lower the cooldown of Splatter (1). |Upgrade into: Superior Cooldown|

2971868509.annotation: Splatter (1), Mystic Shot and Spirit Snatch will trigger this. Allowing you to deal more damage with your melee or gun. |Can be sold for a slot|

1976391348.annotation: Extra burst of damage but requires you to be up close. |Upgrade into: Arctic Blast|

1150006784.annotation: To boost Splatter (1), Cube (2) and Goo Ball (4), but also get extra mobility. |Can be sold for a slot|

3261353684.annotation: Use your whole kit more often! |Upgrade into: Transcendent Cooldown|

395944548.annotation: Consider Scourge instead. Will help you deal extra damage when in melee range.

2121044373.annotation: Even though this isn't a splatter build, this still adds a lot of helpful late game poke.

630839635.annotation: Double Splatter (1) for way more damage. Can also be imbued on The Cube (2) for more life-saving potential.

2519598785.annotation: More damage. Makes your entire kit stronger. The 15% Spirit increase works with Spirit Snatch.

343572757.annotation: Anti-Healing and Extra Burst. Easily triggered by your burst damage. |Replaces Healbane in Late Game|

3812615317.annotation: More damage. A strong burst of damage that interrupts movement. If you tend to be close enough to your target, this can help a lot.

915014646.annotation: Greatly boosts uptime of all abilities!

3577481646.annotation: Extra burst potential, along with a strong slow and lifesteal when using Splatter (1).

98582110.annotation: Good early item for the reveal and resist shred.
